'''Peka''' was an energetic river community on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Batuu]] that lived in a small settlement mostly made up of tents, huts, and cabins made from natural resources. The inhabitants mostly worked in [[fishing]] and [[farm]]ing, and some commuted into [[Black Spire Outpost]].

==Description==
Peka was a small and energetic [[river]] [[City|community]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Batuu]]. It was accessed by a long, packed dirt road.<ref name="shield">{{StoryCite|story=Shield of the Jedi|book=The High Republic: Tales of Light and Life}}</ref> Many residents lived in makeshift tents, huts, or modest log cabins, all built from the native trees<ref name="Traveler's Guide" /> and other natural resources the inhabitants could harvest locally. Other types of housing included apartment buildings built into large spires that could house several families, and large houses that were occupied by single families. There were also small houses made of wood and mud similar in design to the architecture found in [[Black Spire Outpost]], some of which had underground rooms.<ref name="GEStaff">[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] has official backstory elements that, though not directly published for the public, are officially canon details that can be obtained verbally from cast members working in the land.</ref>

==Inhabitants==
The Peka community was inhabited by family-oriented survivalists who centered many of their leisure activities and occupations around the nearby river. In his [[book]] ''[[Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'', [[author]] [[Eloc Throno]] described the inhabitants as welcoming and social to visitors like himself, though they had little room for guests to lodge with them. They would often offer to take off-worlders on [[fishing]] trips where they could catch and cook their own meals.<ref name="Traveler's Guide" /> When they were not working, many Peka locals enjoyed swimming, camping, hiking, or recreational fishing.<ref name="GEStaff" />

The people of Peka often worked within the community as [[farmer]]s or [[fisher]]men, but some commuted an [[Standard hour|hour]] away by [[transport]] to work in Black Spire Outpost, traveling each day from the settlement's depot on a [[shuttle]] belonging to [[Oga Garra]], who owned [[Oga's Cantina]] in the outpost. The shuttle would also return them home at the day's end.<ref name="GEStaff" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Peka was created as part of the backstory for [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], a theme park land that opened to guests on [[May 31]], [[2019]] at [[Disneyland]] Park, and [[August 29]], 2019 at [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]], [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]].<ref name="GEStaff" />
